title: Safe plan export and import from actual VAD CLI use
purpose: Avoid editing results and approvals when a developer creates or updates a VAD plan.
environment: macOS; Python 3.13.2; Git 2.50.1; local repository and disposable test repositories; no external services.
recovery: Revert tools/vad.py and its docs/tests; retain existing schema_version 1 records and all results/approvals. No schema migration.

impact.paths: CLI parser -> execute -> existing paths/load/plan_errors/locked/save. New plan export/import only; record/status/approve/report remain callers of existing validation and storage.
impact.data: Replace only the plan object on validated input. Preserve schema_version, accumulated results and approvals; rejected imports leave bytes unchanged.
impact.permissions: No network, test execution, new credentials or authenticated identities. Existing ID, storage symlink and writer-lock checks apply.
impact.regression: Existing draft refusal, source/plan freshness, approval invalidation, storage error handling and all public commands remain valid.

criteria.AC-1: plan ID prints only the current plan as valid JSON, including an unfinished draft, without writing storage.
criteria.AC-2: plan ID --file FILE validates and replaces only the plan, preserving evidence and approval history.
criteria.AC-3: Invalid JSON, wrong shapes, incomplete plans, missing files, lock conflicts and unsafe storage paths fail without modifying the original record.
criteria.AC-4: Changed plan invalidates prior results and approval; identical import retains validity; blocked results can be corrected by later records.
criteria.AC-5: Existing CLI behavior and documented usage remain consistent; human approval of this actual change is left pending.

regression.procedure: Run targeted existing CLI tests on baseline, then the complete CLI test module after command dispatch changes. Preserve both logs.
regression.expected: Baseline targeted tests and final regression suite pass; no fabricated real human approval.

plan-import.procedure: Reproduce the absent plan command before implementation; run new command-level tests after implementation; export/import this actual plan; check rejected-import preservation and current status.
plan-import.expected: New command succeeds; malformed imports preserve original bytes; plan-only changes preserve history and invalidate old context.

docs.procedure: Validate local Markdown links, fenced blocks, example JSON and git diff --check; inspect actual-case report.
docs.expected: All local links and documented JSON resolve; no whitespace errors; actual case remains Not ready without human approval.

agent_execution.initiating_human: User requested one actual application case and CLI improvements in this chat
agent_execution.tools: Python, Git, local shell, VAD CLI
agent_execution.approval: No human verification approval has been recorded.
